name.name: p53/RUNT-type transcription factor, DNA-binding domain superfamily

description.text: This DNA-binding domain superfamily is found in the p53 and the RUNT families of transcription factors. The DNA-binding domain acts to clamp or encircle the DNA target in order to stabilise the protein-DNA complex. This domain has an immunoglobulin-like fold consisting of a β-sandwich of 9 strands in two sheets with a Greek key topology [[cite:PUB00016331]].
